# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Mail parsing helpers (ported from gmail-ingest.py, generalized multi-mailbox)."""
from __future__ import annotations
import html
import imaplib
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email.utils import getaddresses, parsedate_to_datetime, parseaddr

# A bare number is not a verification code.  In particular, newsletters and
# articles often quote phrases such as "verification code: 2000" as examples.
# Keep the marker deliberately specific and require a code-bearing context.
MARKER = (
    r"(?:验证码|校验码|验证代码|动态码|一次性(?:密码|代码)|安全代码|登录代码|确认代码|"
    r"(?:verification|security|login|authentication|auth)\s+(?:code|password)|"
    r"one[-\s]?time\s+(?:code|password)|(?:2fa|otp)\b)"
)
DIRECT_CODE_MARKER = r"(?:(?:your|the)\s+code\b|(?<![a-z])code\s*(?:is|[:=]))"
CODE_TOKEN = r"((?=[A-Z0-9 -]{0,10}\d)(?:[A-Z0-9]{4,8}|[A-Z0-9]{3}(?:[-\s][A-Z0-9]{3})))"
BROADCAST_HINTS = (
    "newsletter", "news letter", "digest", "substack", "mailchimp", "mailerlite",
    "campaign", "list-unsubscribe", "unsubscribe", "manage preferences",
    "view in browser", "weekly roundup", "monthly roundup",
)

def response_bytes(data) -> bytes:
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    for item in data or []:
        if isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) > 1 and isinstance(item[1], bytes):
            chunks.append(item[1])
    return b"".join(chunks)

def uidvalidity(mail: imaplib.IMAP4_SSL) -> str:
    values = mail.untagged_responses.get("UIDVALIDITY") or []
    for value in values:
        text = value.decode("ascii", errors="ignore") if isinstance(value, bytes) else str(value)
        m = re.search(r"\d+", text)
        if m:
            return m.group(0)
    return "0"

def openai_sender(message) -> str:
    for header in ("Sender", "From", "Reply-To", "Return-Path"):
        address = parseaddr(str(message.get(header) or ""))[1].lower()
        if "@" not in address:
            continue
        domain = address.rsplit("@", 1)[-1]
        if domain == "openai.com" or domain.endswith(".openai.com"):
            return address
    auth_results = " ".join(
        str(value or "")
        for header in ("Authentication-Results", "ARC-Authentication-Results")
        for value in (message.get_all(header, []) or [])
    )
    for domain in re.findall(
        r"dkim=pass[^;]{0,600}?header\.d=([a-z0-9.-]+)",
        auth_results,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        normalized = domain.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
        if normalized == "openai.com" or normalized.endswith(".openai.com"):
            return "dkim:" + normalized
    return ""

def sender_is_openai(message) -> bool:
    return bool(openai_sender(message))

def recipients(message) -> list[str]:
    values: list[str] = []
    for header in ("To", "Delivered-To", "X-Original-To", "X-FORWARDED-TO", "Envelope-To", "X-Forwarded-To"):
        values.extend(str(value or "") for value in (message.get_all(header, []) or []))
    out: list[str] = []
    for _, address in getaddresses(values):
        normalized = address.strip().lower()
        if normalized and normalized not in out:
            out.append(normalized)
    return out

def text_body(message) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    candidates = message.walk() if message.is_multipart() else [message]
    for part in candidates:
        if part.is_multipart() or part.get_content_maintype() != "text":
            continue
        try:
            value = part.get_content()
        except Exception:
            raw = part.get_payload(decode=True) or b""
            value = raw.decode(part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8", errors="replace")
        if part.get_content_subtype() == "html":
            value = html.unescape(str(value))
            value = re.sub(r"<(?:style|script|head)\b[^>]*>.*?</(?:style|script|head)>", " ", value, flags=re.I | re.S)
            value = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", " ", value, flags=re.S)
            value = re.sub(r"<[^>]{1,500}>", " ", value)
        parts.append(str(value))
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", " ".join(parts)).strip()

def _sender_address(value: str) -> str:
    return parseaddr(str(value or ""))[1].strip().lower()


def _subject_has_code_signal(subject: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(
        rf"(?:{MARKER}|{DIRECT_CODE_MARKER})",
        str(subject or ""),
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ))


def is_broadcast_message(sender: str, subject: str = "", body: str = "") -> bool:
    """Return whether the message looks like a newsletter or article digest.

    A broadcast can quote a real verification email verbatim.  Such a quote is
    not a code for the recipient, so body-only code markers must not win over a
    normal newsletter.  An explicit code-bearing subject still takes priority.
    """
    if _subject_has_code_signal(subject):
        return False
    sender_text = str(sender or "").lower()
    address = _sender_address(sender)
    subject_text = str(subject or "").lower()
    body_head = str(body or "")[:6000].lower()
    return (
        any(hint in sender_text or hint in address for hint in BROADCAST_HINTS)
        or any(hint in subject_text for hint in BROADCAST_HINTS)
        or any(hint in body_head for hint in BROADCAST_HINTS)
    )


def _clean_code(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[\s-]+", "", str(value or "")).upper()


def _valid_code(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(
        re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9]{4,8}", value)
        and re.search(r"\d", value)
    )


def extract_code_candidates(subject: str, body: str, sender: str = "") -> list[str]:
    """Extract only high-confidence codes from a direct code message.

    Do not fall back to arbitrary 4-8 digit numbers: dates, amounts, article
    examples, and ticket numbers are common in ordinary mail.  A newsletter is
    also rejected unless its subject explicitly asks for a verification code.
    """
    subject = str(subject or "")
    body = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", " ", str(body or ""))
    if is_broadcast_message(sender, subject, body):
        return []

    text = f"{subject}\n{body}"[:100_000]
    patterns = (
        re.compile(
            rf"(?:{MARKER})[^0-9]{{0,100}}?(?<![A-Za-z0-9]){CODE_TOKEN}(?![A-Za-z0-9])",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
        re.compile(
            rf"(?:{DIRECT_CODE_MARKER})[^0-9]{{0,100}}?(?<![A-Za-z0-9]){CODE_TOKEN}(?![A-Za-z0-9])",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    )
    candidates: list[str] = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            code = _clean_code(match.group(1))
            if _valid_code(code) and code not in candidates:
                candidates.append(code)
    return candidates[:3]


def extract_otp(subject: str, body: str, sender: str = "") -> str:
    return (extract_code_candidates(subject, body, sender) or [""])[0]

def message_time(message) -> str:
    try:
        value = parsedate_to_datetime(str(message.get("Date") or ""))
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    except Exception:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
